title: Brace Expansion II
description: Expand expressions like '{a,b}c{d,e}f' into a sorted list of unique strings.
pseudocode:
1. function expand(expr):
2.   if not '{' in expr: return {expr}
3.   find first brace pair {a,b...}
4.   split into parts: prefix, content, suffix
5.   for each item in content.split(','):
6.     res.addAll(expand(prefix + item + suffix))
7.   return sorted(unique(res))

steps.note: Splitting expression into prefix '', content 'a,b', suffix 'c'
